items.title: Lao authorities charge distillery owners over fatal methanol poisoning
items.description: Bianca Jones and Holly Morton-Bowles, both 19, died after the incident at the Nana Backpackers Hostel in Vang Vieng in November 2024.

items.title: Burnham to become next UK PM after Australian candidate gets one vote
items.description: Andy Burnham will be Britain's seventh prime minister in 10 years next week after winning a Labour leadership contest in which his only challenger, an Australian, received just one vote.

items.title: Live: Crows get vital win over Swans to hit top four
items.description: The Swans take on the Crows in a Friday night blockbuster at the SCG in what could be a preview of this year's qualifying final. Follow live.

items.title: Moira Deeming ousted as Liberal candidate after apology stand-off
items.description: Moira Deeming's political career as a Liberal is over after the party's Victorian state executive voted to revoke the MP's candidacy for the November state election.

items.title: Live: Roosters hold on as Storm winger suffers season-ending injury
items.description: The Sydney Roosters are far from their best but hold on for a gritty 14-6 win over the Melbourne Storm, as Will Warbrick leaves the field in tears after rupturing his Achilles tendon. Follow live.

items.title: Trump's speech a desperate move — and 'ominous sign' ahead of midterms
items.description: Using a prime-time address to the nation to repeat long-debunked claims about the 2020 election defeat is a desperate and unusual move. Analysts say it's an "ominous sign" of how Donald Trump may handle the upcoming midterms.

items.title: Taiwan officials caught off guard as PNG closes trade mission
items.description: Papua New Guinea will close Taiwan's trade mission in the country, freezing out its fifth largest trading partner in a major strategic move designed to reaffirm ties with China.

items.title: Landslide buries people, destroys buildings in south-western China
items.description: A landslide in south-western China's Chongqing municipality has buried people in rubble and destroyed a roadway and a number of buildings, according to state media.

items.title: Trump says 'deep state' officials will be charged in speech claiming voter fraud
items.description: US President Donald Trump uses a presidential speech to accuse China of improperly trying to influence the 2020 election and stop him from winning the presidency.

items.title: No guarantee outages won't happen again, Telstra CEO says
items.description: The national Telstra outage last week was triggered by maintenance work that caused the system's clocks to go back two decades, the telco says.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
